final_message:
Fixed: "Crème brûlée recipes" now becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`, and all 3 tests pass with `npm test`.

The bug was in `vendor/slugify/index.js`, which deletes every character outside `a-z0-9`. That removes accented letters instead of reducing them to their base letters. That file is marked "do not edit by hand", so I left it alone. Instead, `src/blog/slug.js` now strips accents before calling slugify, using Unicode NFD normalization and removing the combining marks.

The shop's `src/shop/product-url.js` also uses the vendored slugify directly, so product URLs with accented names will still lose those letters. I didn't touch it since you only asked about blog posts. If you want the same fix there, it's a one-line change.
